name: Ghost fleet re-flagging (roadmap)
description: One continuous synthetic track changes its broadcast MMSI and display name mid-replay -- a re-flagging/re-registration maneuver real ghost fleets use. Kinematic continuity (no gap, no maneuver) should re-link the pre- and post-change identity to the same track. The new name matches a real OFAC SDN-listed vessel (see geo/ofac_sdn_vessels_subset.csv), which should raise alert severity on the re-link.

expected.notes: actor_1 keeps one continuous kinematic track throughout; only its display_id changes at t=1800s (mmsi:367111222 -> mmsi:572469210). mmsi:572469210 / 'ARTAVIL' is a real OFAC SDN vessel entry (Iran program, crude/oil tanker, f.k.a. 'ALPHA') pulled into geo/ofac_sdn_vessels_subset.csv -- the OFAC-hit check is a real lookup against that subset, not a synthetic label. One attempt per the time box; cut freely if it doesn't land.
